summary: IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones filed a Form 6-K under Rule 13a-16 reporting routine financial results and capital structure details as required by Buenos Aires Stock Exchange regulations. The disclosure covers fiscal year profit, comprehensive income, equity breakdown, share count, market capitalization (approx. USD 1,314 million), and a reminder that warrants (IRS2W/IRSWS) expire on May 12, 2026. There is no transaction, strategic review, or special situation; this is a periodic regulatory update. No deal terms, board action, or advisor is mentioned. The filing is a routine current report, not a special situation.
